title: Friday injury refresh
suggestion: Re-run the deficiency build Friday evening and again Saturday after inactives
problem_it_solves: Official Wednesday/Thursday report has blank game-status for 272 of 278 rows
implementation_sketch: Re-fetch nfl.com injuries page and re-run build_deficiencies.py; diff against prior snapshot
expected_benefit: Deficiency severity reflects official Out status before line release

title: Inactives confirmation gate
suggestion: No line is released for a game until official inactives are captured
problem_it_solves: Starter availability can change between Wednesday report and kickoff
implementation_sketch: Manual capture of official inactives (90 min pre-kickoff) into inactives_2026_wkN.csv with source links
expected_benefit: Removes the largest remaining unknown from every line

title: Official results database
suggestion: Backfill official final scores for weeks 1-9 from nfl.com
problem_it_solves: Strategy gates need graded sample; only Week 8 results exist in repo
implementation_sketch: Script fetching official schedule pages week by week into data/results_2026_reg.csv with source_url per row
expected_benefit: Unlocks gate G1 backtests and correlation estimates

title: Market-line capture policy
suggestion: Decide whether to manually capture market lines from licensed screens
problem_it_solves: CLV gate and model-vs-market QA are blocked because no official source publishes market lines
implementation_sketch: If approved: manual capture sheet with timestamp + operator + source link per row; if declined: keep columns blank and flag permanently
expected_benefit: Unlocks G2/G3 and honest market comparison

title: Depth-chart change detector
suggestion: Daily diff of all 28 official club depth charts
problem_it_solves: Chart changes (starter flips) are a leading indicator of inactive surprises
implementation_sketch: Script re-fetching club depth-chart URLs and diffing CSV rows; alert on any starter-cell change
expected_benefit: Early warning for line moves we model

title: QB-change starter module
suggestion: Flag every team whose official chart QB1 differs from who actually starts
problem_it_solves: Backup-QB starts materially change totals and spreads
implementation_sketch: Join official inactives against chart QB1 each week; emit qb_change_flag rows

title: Official weather ingest
suggestion: Add game-center weather to the totals advisory
implementation_sketch: Manual or scripted capture from official game centers on game day

title: Correlation engine
suggestion: Compute pairwise leg correlations once 4+ weeks of official results exist
problem_it_solves: Parlay gate G4 cannot evaluate without joint outcome history
implementation_sketch: Extend compute_analysis.py: weekly win vectors per team then pairwise Pearson correlations
expected_benefit: Unlocks parlay strategies with honest sizing

title: HOU chart transcription
suggestion: Manually transcribe the image-only Texans depth chart with a second-person check
problem_it_solves: HOU backup strings are missing from every deficiency row
implementation_sketch: Dual transcription compared automatically; disagreement = flag not guess
risk: Transcription error risk — mitigated by dual-check + flagging

title: Auto-grading leaderboard
suggestion: Grade strategies automatically when official final scores land
problem_it_solves: Leaderboard stays pending until graded bets exist
implementation_sketch: Script joining model lines to official results: win/loss per leg, push on 0 margin; updates leaderboard metrics
expected_benefit: Turns leaderboard from template into live competition

title: Weekly flagged review
suggestion: Review flagged.html before staking each week
problem_it_solves: Flagged items must be visible decisions not buried notes
implementation_sketch: Standing agenda item: every unverified row gets accept/reject from user

title: Rest and travel signal
suggestion: Encode short weeks and international travel from the official schedule
problem_it_solves: Munich game and Thursday games create rest asymmetry
implementation_sketch: Schedule parser flags teams on short rest or long-haul travel before each week
expected_benefit: Adds an explainable skill-based input to lines
